nary_nodes.label: 2004 Sumatra earthquake and tsunami
evidence: A devastating 9.1-magnitude tremor in 2004 struck off the coast of Sumatra and triggered a tsunami that killed 220,000 throughout the region, about 170,000 of them in Indonesia, in one of the deadliest natural disasters in recorded history.

nary_nodes.label: Suharyanto states people trapped
evidence: Suharyanto, who leads the BNPB, said earlier that people were trapped in several buildings.

nary_nodes.label: Suharyanto identifies response targets
evidence: "These will be the initial targets of the disaster response teams," said Suharyanto, who like many Indonesians uses one name.

nary_nodes.label: EU offers Copernicus satellite help
evidence: European Union chief Ursula von der Leyen offered help from the bloc's Copernicus Earth observation satellites.
"Europe stands ready to deploy Copernicus, our eyes in the sky, to support search and rescue efforts. Indonesia, we stand with you," she wrote on X.

nary_nodes.label: Yulian describes earthquake experience
evidence: "I have never felt an earthquake this big," Yulian Juita Ekalia, who lives in Ruteng city more than 100 kilometres (60 miles) west of the epicentre, told AFP by telephone hours after the tremor.
"It felt like we were on a trampoline; it was really scary," said the 37-year-old university lecturer, who was jolted awake at around 5:30am (21:30 GMT on Friday).

nary_nodes.label: Yulian observes items falling
evidence: "As I rushed to get outside, everything in the house fell down: the television, my son's trophies, the dish racks, suitcases on top of the wardrobes. When I got outside, my son and neighbours were already there, screaming in fear."

nary_nodes.label: Fathur states rescue focus
evidence: Rescue official Fathur told AFP the focus was on locating victims who may be buried under rubble, but rescue efforts have been complicated by landslides cutting off roads.

nary_nodes.label: Authorities urge against returning to damaged buildings
evidence: While a tsunami warning was lifted, authorities urged people not to return to damaged buildings for fear that aftershocks may bring them down.

nary_nodes.label: Yulian cooks outside due to fear
evidence: Yulian said she had dragged her stove outside and was cooking there, fearing further tremors.

nary_nodes.label: Yulian observes patients treated outside hospital
evidence: She said she saw patients being treated under emergency tents outside a nearby hospital.

nary_nodes.label: Yohanes describes earthquake experience
evidence: Nagekeo resident Yohanes Babo, 56, said he was at a market when the earth started shaking in the early morning hours.
"The shaking was strong. Thankfully, we were already outside the house," he told AFP.
"People were panicking, running here and there. We're evacuating for the time being... and trying to get to the hills," he said.

nary_nodes.label: Authorities state epicentre location
evidence: The epicentre of the shallow quake was located just off the north coast of the island, US and Indonesian authorities said.

nary_nodes.label: Indonesia experiences frequent earthquakes
evidence: Indonesia experiences frequent earthquakes due to its location in the Pacific "Ring of Fire", an arc of intense seismic activity stretching from Japan through Southeast Asia and across the Pacific basin.
